title: Unique normalized ordinary signed-line reduction
statement: Fix a finite coefficient setting P [def-pur-conventions], positive levels $1\le m\le n=P.level$, and a scheme T over $\operatorname{Spec}(P.field.k)$. Use the actual integral-reduced signed module sheaves $A_T(r)$ and $B_T(r)$, the quotient $A_n\to A_m$, and the semilinear-map predicate of [def-pur-finite-tensor-reduction-data]. There exists exactly one family $c_r:A_T(r)\to\operatorname{Res}_{A_n}^{A_m}B_T(r)$ normalized by the coefficient quotient at r=0, integral scalar balancing at r=1, the ordered tensor recursion at positive r, and dual evaluation at negative r. This statement concerns ordinary sheaf maps only, without derived objects or chosen derived isomorphisms.

proof.text: Identify each positive-level first line with the actual scalar extension of purTwistIntegralOne. The quotient maps compose, so scalarExtensionTowerIso gives the degree-one comparison. Its pure-section formula is exactly integral balancing.

Obtain trivializing covers for the first lines from their existing rank-one theorem. Apply exists_signedLineComparison to the degree-one comparison, and compose each comparison with scalarExtensionEmbedding. The unit comparison formula, ordered tensor recursion and signed evaluation formula give all four normalization clauses.

The normalization fixes degree zero. The scalar-extension hom extensionality theorem and the integral-balancing clause fix degree one; tensor hom extensionality and two-step induction fix all positive degrees. For negative degrees lift two competing semilinear maps along scalar extension and precompose their dual values with the positive comparison isomorphism. scalarExtensionDual_hom_ext detects equality on pure tensors, where the evaluation normalization gives the same value. Cancel the invertible precomposition map, and evaluate the scalar-extension lifts on x tensor 1 to recover equality of the original maps. Function extensionality yields equality of the full families.

lean.statement: theorem existsUnique_finiteTensorSemilinearReduction (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmn : m ≤ P.level) (T : Scheme.{u}) [T.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))] : ∃! c : P.FiniteTensorLineMaps m hm hmn T, P.FiniteTensorLineMapsNormalized m hm hmn T c
